column1: The onboarding was confusing and took too long.
Love the new dashboard, it's so much faster now!
Support team was helpful but the docs are seriously outdated.
Pricing feels high compared to competitors.
Great product overall, would recommend to my team.
Crashed twice this week, really frustrating.
The mobile app is way better than the desktop version.
Feature requests take forever to get addressed.
Signing up was way too complicated, I almost gave up.
The search feature is broken, results make no sense.
I love how fast the app loads compared to competitors.
The billing page is confusing, I got charged twice.
Onboarding emails were super helpful and well timed.
I've been waiting 3 weeks for a response from support.
Would 100% recommend this to my colleagues.
